mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'PREPARING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preparing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'SHIPPING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipping_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_count FROM ORDERS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SHIPPING WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND carrier IS NOT NULL AND carrier != '' AND tracking_number IS NOT NULL AND tracking_number != ''
mapper.update: UPDATE SHIPPING SET shipping_status = #{shippingStatus}, shipped_at = CASE WHEN #{shippingStatus} = 'SHIPPING' THEN NOW() ELSE shipped_at END, delivered_at = CASE WHEN #{shippingStatus} = 'DELIVERED' THEN NOW() ELSE delivered_at END WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_number, o.order_type, o.order_status, o.ordered_at, m.member_id, m.name AS member_name, m.email AS member_email, m.phone AS member_phone, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.postal_code, o.address, o.address_detail, o.product_amount, o.shipping_fee, o.customs_duty, o.discount_amount, o.total_amount, pay.payment_method, pay.payment_status, pay.paid_at, pay.cancelled_at, s.shipping_status, s.carrier, s.tracking_number, s.shipped_at, s.delivered_at FROM ORDERS o JOIN MEMBER m ON m.member_id = o.member_id LEFT JOIN PAYMENT pay ON pay.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN SHIPPING s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.sale_type, oi.product_name, p.thumbnail_url, oi.price_jpy, oi.quantity, oi.item_total FROM ORDER_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id
